block.field: High/Low Tick AI armed — R_100, five-tick contract. Eight experts and the arcsine structure of a random walk vote on which tick prints the strict high or low; the entry must clear the payout break-even, the model agreement, the confidence floor, the rule's own graded record and the risk gate, and the buy sends the chosen prediction tick.
AI is ready but the entry gate held it — the confidence floor, a losing-streak cool-off, the balance percentage, the loss limit or the profit target blocked this entry.
AI session stop — the loss limit, the profit target or the balance rule was reached. Open contracts still settle; restart the bot to begin a new session.
